key_insight: Energy-Arena introduces a dynamic, operationally realistic benchmarking platform that closes the comparability gap in energy forecasting by evaluating models on rolling, up-to-date windows and standardized scoring. This enables fair, reproducible comparisons of forecasting methods under realistic information sets.
problem_solved: Current energy-forecasting results are hard to compare because studies use different datasets, time periods, features, and scoring rules; fixed historical benchmarks don't reflect operational, evolving conditions.
method: Dynamic benchmark design: use rolling evaluation windows and live-like data snapshots so models are tested under changing, operational conditions.
Standardized information sets and scoring: define common input feature views and consistent error metrics to ensure apples-to-apples comparisons.
Open platform & leaderboards: provide an extensible evaluation pipeline, reproducible data versioning, and continuously updated leaderboards for tracking progress.
impact: AI/ML practitioners get a reproducible, operationally meaningful way to evaluate and compare forecasting models, accelerating reliable progress and practical deployment in energy systems.

paper_title: Energy-Arena: A Dynamic Benchmark for Operational Energy Forecasting
paper_authors: Max Kleinebrahm, Jonathan Berrisch, Philipp Eiser, Wolf Fichtner, Veit Hagenmeyer
